title: Running Total
description: Write a function named running_total that returns a new list where each item is the sum of all items up to that position in the input list. Do not mutate the original list.
hints: Prefix sums accumulate totals sequentially as you iterate through an array.
Inspect the accumulator variable: make sure you reset or maintain a rolling sum that updates on each iteration.
Avoid modifying the original nums list in-place (e.g. nums[i] += nums[i-1]), as this violates non-mutation rules.
Create a new result list, keep a running sum variable starting at 0, add each element to it, and append the sum to result.
